register.idempotency: Idempotency-Key = canonical operationId UUID = uploadId; same actor+original inputs only

upload.idempotency: original uploadId header and original mediaType; explicit same File retry only

query.identity: original uploading actor with current MONEY_READ, read+purpose capability and company scope

response.fileId: stable privateFileId sent to finance money commands; not uploadId

download.identity: current EMPLOYEE with finance.money.read, enabled department and current immutable ticket company scope; not restricted to uploader; no collect/refund capability required for read
download.range: one bytes=start-end, bytes=start- or bytes=-suffix; 206 for valid range; 416 invalid; identity checked before bytes

legacyUploadDownload.identity: original actor plus current read and purpose capability

fact.state: AVAILABLE only exact READY binding plus current physical size/hash; not proof of real money
fact.authorization: MONEY_READ + finance.money.read + collect/refund matching purpose, enabled EMPLOYEE department and current company scope

ownership: completed ticket_create_operation and immutable ticket_record.company_id; deterministic group UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(UTF8 finance:tenant:company:ticket)
transaction: UPLOADING registered with immutable audit; independent stage validated then actor freshly reauthorized before row lock; stable bin moved atomically; READY+audit same DB transaction; failed audit/commit cannot expose UPLOADING file; original File retry validates existing bin
recovery: 404 never means deletion or abort; do not auto resend; unknown stays original UUID and parameters; READY original same File replay never duplicates bin/audit
cleanup: no automatic delete; only own random stage removed; possible post-MOVE UPLOADING bin retained for recovery; no scan/delete of other files or old private backups
